paragraphs: Mentioned in [Gittin 14b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.14b.12) and [15a (Hyman cites 26a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.15a.4). The Gemara asks whether he was a Nasi or spoke in the Nasi’s name.[^1]

notes.text: Gittin 14b names Rabbi Shimon HaNasi as the speaker reporting an incident. On 15a the Gemara asks whether he held the office or spoke in the Nasi’s name. It leaves the question unresolved.
